subject: general
question: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio was a teacher of which college in 1820s?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindu college, Calcutta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Henry Louis Vivian Derozio:-**

 
 
• He was an Indian poet, philosopher, and assistant headmaster of Hindu College in Kolkata in the 1820s.
 
• He was a radical thinker of his time and one of the first Indian educators to disseminate Western learning and science among the young men of Bengal. 
 
• He was educated at the Anglo-Indian College, where he excelled in his studies. 
 
• **After graduating, he was appointed as a teacher at Hindu College. (Hence option 1 is correct)**
 
 
 
• **Hindu College, Calcutta:-**
 
 
• It is an educational institution in the city of Kolkata, West Bengal, India.
 
• **It was founded on 20 January 1817 and is one of the oldest colleges in India.**
 
• Hindu College played a vital role in the spread and promotion of modern education in India during the British Raj.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Banaras Engineering College:-**

 
 
• It is now known as the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi.
 
• It is one of the oldest engineering colleges in India.
 
• **It was founded in 1919 by Bharat Ratna Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya, the founder of Banaras Hindu University (BHU). **
 
• The college offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in engineering, as well as research programs.
 
 
 
• **Indian Institute of Science Bangalore:-**
 
 
• It is located in the southern Indian city of Bangalore, Karnataka.
 
• **The institute was established in 1909 with active support from Jamsetji Tata and thus is also locally known as the "Tata Institute".**
 
• It was granted a deemed university status in 1958 and recognized as an Institute of Eminence in 2018.
 
 
 
• **Sanskrit College, Varanasi:-**
 
 
• It is a government college located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• **It was founded in 1837 and is one of the oldest Sanskrit colleges in India. **
 
• The purpose of the college is to promote the study and preservation of Sanskrit.
